Write tools/acceptance.mjs: the whole design (all exports). Keep it under 9000 characters.
Return each output file complete in files, never edits. ES modules, no dependencies, node:test and node:assert/strict for tests, no secrets in code or tests. Write backslashes in strings as String.fromCharCode(92) or avoid them (use character classes and RegExp built with new RegExp from strings that have no backslash); never write a lone backslash literal. Keep code readable with real line breaks, one statement per line.
